name: Martin Villanueva
title: Developer & designer
bio: I turn complex ideas into intuitive, quietly confident digital experiences.
about: I'm Martin, a developer with a designer's eye and a genuine curiosity for how things work. I enjoy bringing an idea from the first rough sketch all the way to a polished, working product. My interests span thoughtful interface design, full-stack development, and machine learning that solves meaningful problems.

projects.name: DeepBreath
projects.description: Exploring how cough-sound analysis can help make early health insights more accessible.
projects.details: A research-driven concept exploring audio classification for preliminary pneumonia screening. Built an early model using a ResNet-34 architecture and logistic regression, then prepared a cloud staging environment on AWS for initial evaluation.

projects.name: Digital home
projects.description: A little corner of the internet for the work, ideas, and details that make me who I am.
projects.details: A personal portfolio designed to bring software engineering and a visual design sensibility together. Made with React and TypeScript, with responsive layouts, motion details, and an editable content system.

projects.name: Cloud-ready workflow
projects.description: A practical deployment and testing workflow, shaped during a government tech internship.
projects.details: Worked on quality assurance, organized project files and cloud deployment configurations, and maintained database records during an internship with the Philippine Department of Information and Communications Technology.

experience.company: Department of Information and Communications Technology
